requirements.text: The Communication Management module provides a centralized system for storing, organizing, searching, reviewing, and linking parenting-related communications. It is intended to capture communication records that may originate from email, OurFamilyWizard (OFW), text-message exports, call logs, voicemail recordings, screenshots, and other supported communication sources represented by the supplied requirements.
requirements.status: Untriaged; see Traceability.md for validated partial coverage

requirements.text: The module shall preserve the original imported or uploaded communication artifact while generating searchable metadata, OCR text, speech-to-text transcripts, AI summaries, and relationships to other application records. Communication records shall integrate with the Parenting Journal, Calendar, Timeline, Evidence Management, Reports, Contacts, Parenting Time, Expenses, and AI Assistant.

requirements.text: The source material supplied for this module primarily described Evidence Management. This functional specification therefore focuses on the communication-related capabilities explicitly represented in that source, including OFW message exports, text-message exports, email files, call logs, voicemail recordings, social-media screenshots, OCR, transcription, AI analysis, search, linking, reporting, version history, security, and audit history. Communication-specific behaviors not supported by the supplied requirements are identified as product decisions rather than silently assumed.

requirements.text: The Parenting Time module serves as the authoritative system for planning, recording, validating, and reporting all parenting time within the ClearParent Log platform. It maintains a complete historical record of scheduled parenting time, actual parenting time, exchanges, cancellations, denials, make-up parenting time, and parenting plan compliance.
requirements.status: Untriaged; see Traceability.md for validated partial coverage

requirements.text: Unlike a traditional calendar, the Parenting Time module compares what was expected to occur under the parenting plan with what actually occurred. This comparison enables users to accurately document parenting plan compliance, identify missed or denied parenting time, calculate parenting statistics, and generate comprehensive reports for personal records, attorneys, parenting coaches, therapists, mediators, Guardian ad Litems, and court proceedings.
